SELECT r.ID, r.NAME, r.DESCRIPTION, r.CATEGORY, r.AVG_RATING, r.RATING_COUNT, r.SOLO_INDEX, r.PHOTO_URL, r.LATITUDE, r.LONGITUDE, r.ADDRESS, r.PHONE FROM MP_RESTAURANT r
JOIN MP_RESTAURANT_TAG t ON r.ID = t.RESTAURANT_ID JOIN MP_CODE_TAG c ON t.TAG_CODE = c.CODE WHERE c.TAG = #{tag} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
WHERE DELETED_AT IS NULL
ORDER BY ${sortField} ${sortDirection}
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY, AVG_RATING, RATING_COUNT, SOLO_INDEX, PHOTO_URL, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, ADDRESS, PHONE FROM MP_RESTAURANT WHERE ID = #{id}
SELECT t.restaurant_id AS restaurantId, c.tag AS tag FROM mp_code_tag c, mp_restaurant_tag t WHERE c.code = t.tag_code AND t.restaurant_id = #{restaurantId}
